internalHelpers.body:
const guard = (record: null | { status: string; stage: string; intent?: unknown; finalReport?: unknown }): boolean =>
		record !== null
		&& record.status === 'ok'
		&& record.stage === 'done'
		&& record.intent !== undefined
		&& record.finalReport !== undefined;
